en.why: The camera starts tight on the chat panel and stays on it, moving through it, for the first 5.9s. The 21px interface text is scaled 1.75–1.85x to about 37–39px, so the prompt, the bubble and the tool-card titles all read. The preview beside it is just a dotted grid and Nothing to preview yet during that time, so the eye has one place to go. Things happen in cause-and-effect order with room between them: typing takes 1.25s, the bubble springs up on send, Thinking… holds for 1.15s, and the three tool cards appear 0.65–0.7s apart and each spins for 0.52–0.62s before it ticks, so every step can be read. On the same frame the last card ticks (5.95s) the preview swaps to the dashboard, the reply starts streaming 0.05s later, and the camera pulls back over 1.15s from 5.9s, so the chat and its result share one frame and the viewer reads this sentence made this app. The dashboard builds in parts: title, stat cards, chart and list come in one after another, the numbers count and the bars rise one by one, so something is moving in the frame through the pull-back until 7.8s. Specific tool-card titles and subtitles (a file name, line count, column count, component count) make the AI's steps believable. The light background has one accent, purple: the bubble, the send button, the ticks and the Nov bar are all the same purple, and the pink in the progress bar and the streaming words appears only on things that are being generated.
spec: Timing

Film 10.5s. Window fades in 0–1.0s; typing 0.7–1.95s (51 characters); send at 2.1s; bubble springs up from 2.2s (0.85s); Thinking… appears at 2.85s and becomes Thought for 2s at 4.0s; tool cards appear at 4.0s, 4.7s and 5.35s with ticks at 4.62s, 5.22s and 5.95s; preview progress bar 4.0–6.0s; thread scrolls up 84px at 5.8s; reply streams 6.0–7.53s (19 words, 0.085s apart); preview swaps to the dashboard at 5.95s and its parts build 6.0–7.8s; camera pulls back 5.9–7.05s; window fades 8.2–8.55s; lockup at 8.45s and holds to the end at 10.5s
Easing

Window fade-in, Thinking… appearance, tool-card entrances, dashboard rises and bar growth expo.out; user bubble back.out(1.25), send-button bounce back.out(2.4), ticks back.out(2.6), sparkle icon back.out(2); camera sine.inOut on the chat panel (power2.inOut for the 2.3–3.6s move), pull-back expo.inOut, then sine.out; progress bar and Thinking shimmer power1.inOut; number counts and each reply word's fade-in power2.out; background blobs sine.inOut
Camera

Opens at 1.75x with the composer just below screen centre (screen y=600). 0–2.3s stays on the composer, 1.75→1.78x (sine.inOut); 2.3–3.6s a 1.3s move (power2.inOut) up to the user bubble and Thinking…, 1.8x; 3.6–5.9s a 2.3s move (sine.inOut) to the tool-card stack, 1.85x; 5.9–7.05s a 1.15s pull-back (expo.inOut) to 1.16x showing the whole window; 7.05–8.55s a 1.5s push (sine.out) to 1.2x. The window has 2600px perspective: rotateY −3° and rotateX 1.2°, easing to −2° and 0.8° over the first 5.9s, then to −0.6° and 0.3° during the pull-back
Subject

App window 1500x840px, 26px corners; chat panel 560px on the left, preview panel 940px on the right holding a 900x800px browser frame with 20px corners (address bar invoice-studio.mosaic.app, Publish button top right). Composer 512x148px with 26px corners and a 46px round send button; user bubble 420px wide with 24/24/8/24px corners and 21px white text; tool cards 504x64px with 18px corners, 92px apart, 19px titles, 14.5px monospace subtitles and a 28px spinner or tick on the right; reply 21px text on a 31px line height, 504px wide. Dashboard: three stat cards of 266x106px (Revenue $48,200, Outstanding $12,850, Overdue $3,240), a Monthly revenue chart 540x268px with 8 bars 38px wide on a 62px pitch (Apr–Nov, Nov in a purple gradient), an Overdue card 274x268px listing 3 overdue invoices with a Send reminders button, and a Recent invoices table 830x222px with three rows. Lockup mark 156px
Sync

The placeholder disappears the moment the first character lands at 0.7s and the send button turns purple over 0.25s from 0.72s; at 2.1s the send press (button down to 0.84, ring expanding), the composer text clearing at 2.22s and the bubble springing up from the composer's position at 2.2s run together; on the 4.0s frame Thinking… becomes Thought for 2s, the first tool card appears and the preview progress bar starts; at 5.95s the third card ticks, the placeholder page fades, the dashboard appears and the browser frame flashes a purple glow, and the reply starts streaming at 6.0s; the three stat numbers count for 1.1s from 6.3s, 6.4s and 6.5s, and the $48.2k tag pops above the Nov bar at 7.15s
Style

Background #f4effb with five radial blobs (#ffd1c9, #c9d6ff, #f8c4e8, #cdeeff, #e2d6ff) drifting slowly over the 10.5s; text #1d1a2e, accent purple #6a4cf6, the progress bar running from #8f78ff to pink #e55fbe, and new streaming words going purple to pink; Inter throughout with monospace for the tool-card subtitles; white window with four layers of soft purple-tinted shadow; wordmark Mosaic at 176px weight 700 with the tagline Describe it. Watch it build. at 34px; grain at 6% opacity in multiply mode and a pale-lavender vignette (16% at the edges)
en.prompt: Build a 10.5-second, 1920x1080, 30 fps light product film called Chat Animation for a fictional product, Mosaic (an AI tool that builds an app from one sentence). Background #f4effb with five radial-gradient blobs (#ffd1c9, #c9d6ff, #f8c4e8, #cdeeff, #e2d6ff) drifting slowly over the 10.5s with sine.inOut; text #1d1a2e, accent purple #6a4cf6, and pink #e55fbe used only on things that are being generated; font Inter, with 14.5px monospace for tool-card subtitles. The frame is one white app window, 1500x840px with 26px corners and several soft purple-tinted shadows: a 560px chat panel on the left and a 940px preview panel on the right. The chat panel has a 64px header (a 30px purple rounded mark and Invoice Studio) and, at the bottom, a composer of 512x148px with 26px corners, the placeholder Ask Mosaic…, and below it a plus button, a Plan chip and a 46px round send button at the bottom right (light grey #dedaf0 by default); the thread starts with one welcome line, Hi, I’m Mosaic. Describe the app you want and I’ll build it piece by piece. The preview panel holds a 900x800px browser frame with 20px corners (address bar invoice-studio.mosaic.app, a Publish button at the top right), showing a dotted grid and Nothing to preview yet. Put all state in one paused GSAP timeline, with no CSS animations. The camera starts tight, scaling the whole window 1.75x with the composer just below screen centre, and then moves only over the chat panel: 0–2.3s it stays on the composer, 1.75→1.78x (sine.inOut); 2.3–3.6s a 1.3s move (power2.inOut) up to the user bubble and Thinking…, 1.8x; 3.6–5.9s a 2.3s move (sine.inOut) to the tool-card stack, 1.85x; 5.9–7.05s a 1.15s pull-back (expo.inOut) to 1.16x showing the whole window; 7.05–8.55s a slow push to 1.2x (sine.out). Give the window 2600px perspective, rotateY −3° and rotateX 1.2°, easing to −2° and 0.8° over the first 5.9s and to −0.6° and 0.3° during the pull-back; the window fades in over 0–1.0s from 40px below (expo.out). Timeline: from 0.7 to 1.95s the prompt Make an invoicing dashboard for my freelance studio is typed into the composer (51 characters at slightly uneven speed; before 0.7s the caret blinks every 0.5s, and the placeholder disappears at 0.7s) and the send button turns purple over 0.25s from 0.72s. At 2.1s Send is pressed: the button squashes to 0.84 and bounces back (back.out(2.4)), a purple ring expands to 1.9x and fades over 0.5s, the composer text clears at 2.22s and the placeholder fades back at 2.65s. The user bubble springs into the thread from 2.2s over 0.85s, starting from the composer's position (470px below, 40px left, scale 0.9, origin at its bottom right, back.out(1.25)): 420px wide, purple gradient #7656fa→#6243f0, corners 24/24/8/24px, 21px white text. At 2.85s Thinking… appears (a sparkle icon turns upright with back.out(2) and a purple highlight sweeps across the text over 1.1s, power1.inOut); at 4.0s it fades and a collapsed row Thought for 2s › takes its place. Three tool cards of 504x64px, 18px corners and a 1.5px border sit 92px apart and appear at 4.0s, 4.7s and 5.35s (0.5s expo.out, from 20px below, scale 0.97→1); the spinner on the right turns two full rotations and is replaced by a purple round tick at 4.62s, 5.22s and 5.95s (0.4s back.out(2.6)); a 2px purple connector line grows between cards at 4.55s and 5.15s (0.3s). The cards read Read schema.ts (src/db/schema.ts · 84 lines), Create table invoices (8 columns · 2 indexes) and Generate dashboard (Dashboard.tsx · 4 components). At 5.8s the thread moves up 84px (0.8s expo.out). In the preview, a 3px purple-to-pink progress bar appears at the top at 4.0s and fills over 2.0s (power1.inOut), fading at 6.15s; at 5.95s the placeholder page fades, the dashboard appears and the browser frame flashes a purple glow (3px outline plus a 40px glow, 0.25s in, 0.8s out from 6.3s). The reply streams from 6.0s, 19 words 0.085s apart (to 7.53s): each word fades in and rises 6px (0.3s power2.out), new words are purple-to-pink first and turn to body colour over 0.5s starting 0.18s later, and a caret follows the newest word and blinks away after the last. The reply reads Your invoicing dashboard is live. It tracks monthly revenue, flags 3 overdue invoices and sends reminders in one click. The dashboard builds in parts from 6.0s (rise 0.65s expo.out): the title Invoices, the month and the New invoice button at 6.0–6.1s; three stat cards of 266x106px rise at 6.18s, 6.28s and 6.38s, and their numbers count over 1.1s from 6.3s, 6.4s and 6.5s to $48,200, $12,850 and $3,240 (power2.out); the 540x268px Monthly revenue chart appears at 6.45s and its 8 bars (38px wide, 62px pitch, Apr–Nov, Nov in a purple gradient) rise every 0.06s from 6.6s (0.8s expo.out), with a $48.2k tag popping in at 7.15s (back.out(2)); the Overdue card appears at 6.6s with three overdue invoices from 6.75s and a Send reminders button at 7.05s; the Recent invoices table appears at 6.8s with its three rows from 6.95s. The window fades out over 8.2–8.55s; at 8.45s the lockup appears: a 156px purple mark (four white squares popping in one after another), Mosaic (176px, weight 700) and Describe it. Watch it build. (34px), held to the end. Finish with 6% grain in multiply mode and a pale-lavender vignette.
says: A sentence is typed into the composer and the bubble springs into the thread when it is sent
The AI thinks first, then runs tool steps one after another, each spinning and then ticking off
The preview beside the chat builds the app at the same time
vs: Rhythmic Typing is monospace characters and a caret on a dark background and covers only the typing; here the typing sits in a real composer and is followed by a bubble, thinking, tool steps and an app that builds at the same time.

Zoom to Cursor pushes in fast for one click or input and pulls back; here the camera follows the chat slowly down through four stages (typing, thinking, tool steps, reply) and pulls back once, when the result appears.

zh.why: 镜头一开始就贴在对话栏上，前 5.9s 一直在对话栏里移动，21px 的界面文字放大 1.75–1.85 倍后约 37–39px，提示词、气泡和工具卡标题都读得清。这段时间预览区只是一块点阵加 Nothing to preview yet，观众的注意力只有一处。事情按因果顺序一件一件发生，每件之间留出时间：打字 1.25s，发送后气泡弹起，Thinking… 停 1.15s，三张工具卡每张转 0.52–0.62s 再打钩，间隔 0.65–0.7s 出现，每一步都读得到。最后一张卡打钩的同一帧（5.95s）预览区换成仪表盘，0.05s 后回复开始流出，镜头在 5.9s 起用 1.15s 拉远，对话和结果出现在同一个画面里，观众看到的是这句话做出了这个应用。仪表盘分件长出：标题、指标卡、图表、列表依次出现，数字滚动，柱子逐根升起，拉远的同时画面里一直有东西在动，到 7.8s 才停。工具卡的标题和副标题（文件名、行数、列数、组件数）用具体内容，AI 的步骤读起来可信。浅色背景只有一个紫色强调色：气泡、发送按钮、对勾和 Nov 柱子都是同一个紫色；进度条和流式文字里的粉色只出现在正在生成的东西上。
spec: 时长

全片 10.5s。窗口 0–1.0s 淡入；打字 0.7–1.95s（51 个字符）；2.1s 发送；气泡 2.2s 起用 0.85s 弹起；Thinking… 2.85s 出现，4.0s 换成 Thought for 2s；工具卡 4.0s、4.7s、5.35s 出现，对勾在 4.62s、5.22s、5.95s；预览进度条 4.0–6.0s；线程 5.8s 上移 84px；回复 6.0–7.53s 逐词流出（19 个词，间隔 0.085s）；5.95s 预览换成仪表盘，各部分 6.0–7.8s 长出；镜头 5.9–7.05s 拉远；窗口 8.2–8.55s 淡出；字标 8.45s 出现，保持到片尾 10.5s
缓动

窗口淡入、Thinking… 出现、工具卡出现、仪表盘各部分上升和柱子升起 expo.out；用户气泡 back.out(1.25)，发送按钮回弹 back.out(2.4)，对勾 back.out(2.6)，星花图标 back.out(2)；镜头在对话栏上 sine.inOut（2.3–3.6s 一段 power2.inOut），拉远 expo.inOut，之后 sine.out；进度条和 Thinking 高光 power1.inOut；数字滚动和回复每个词的淡入 power2.out；背景色块 sine.inOut
镜头

开场放大 1.75 倍，输入框在屏幕中心下方（屏幕 y=600）。0–2.3s 停在输入框，1.75→1.78 倍（sine.inOut）；2.3–3.6s 用 1.3s（power2.inOut）上移到用户气泡和 Thinking…，1.8 倍；3.6–5.9s 用 2.3s（sine.inOut）移到工具卡堆，1.85 倍；5.9–7.05s 用 1.15s（expo.inOut）拉远到 1.16 倍，露出整个窗口；7.05–8.55s 用 1.5s（sine.out）缓推到 1.2 倍。窗口带 2600px 透视：rotateY −3°、rotateX 1.2°，前 5.9s 缓到 −2°、0.8°，拉远时回到 −0.6°、0.3°
主体

应用窗口 1500x840px，圆角 26px；左边对话栏 560px，右边预览区 940px，内有 900x800px、圆角 20px 的浏览器框（地址栏 invoice-studio.mosaic.app，右上 Publish 按钮）。输入框 512x148px，圆角 26px，发送按钮 46px 圆形；用户气泡 420px 宽，圆角 24/24/8/24px，21px 白字；工具卡 504x64px，圆角 18px，每张间距 92px，标题 19px，副标题 14.5px 等宽字，右侧 28px 的转圈和对勾；回复 21px，行高 31px，宽 504px。仪表盘：三张指标卡各 266x106px（Revenue $48,200、Outstanding $12,850、Overdue $3,240），Monthly revenue 图 540x268px，8 根 38px 宽的柱子（Apr–Nov，间距 62px，Nov 是紫色渐变），Overdue 卡 274x268px，列 3 张逾期发票并带 Send reminders 按钮，Recent invoices 表 830x222px，三行。字标方块 156px
同步

第一个字符 0.7s 出现的同一刻占位文字消失，0.72s 发送按钮用 0.25s 变紫；2.1s 按下发送，按钮缩到 0.84、光环扩散、输入框文字 2.22s 清空，气泡 2.2s 从输入框的位置弹起；4.0s 的同一帧里 Thinking… 换成 Thought for 2s、第一张工具卡出现、预览进度条开始；5.95s 第三张卡打钩、占位页淡出、仪表盘出现、浏览器框亮一圈紫光，6.0s 回复开始流出；三个指标数字 6.3s、6.4s、6.5s 起滚动 1.1s，$48.2k 标签 7.15s 在 Nov 柱子上方弹出
风格

背景 #f4effb，加 5 团径向色块（#ffd1c9、#c9d6ff、#f8c4e8、#cdeeff、#e2d6ff），10.5s 内缓慢漂移；文字 #1d1a2e，强调色紫 #6a4cf6，进度条从 #8f78ff 渐变到粉 #e55fbe，流式文字的新词也是紫到粉；全片 Inter，工具卡副标题用等宽字；窗口白底，叠 4 层带紫色调的柔和阴影；字标 Mosaic 176px、字重 700，标语 Describe it. Watch it build. 34px；6% 不透明度 multiply 的颗粒，淡紫色暗角（边缘 16%）

en.title: Chat Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A prompt typed into a chat, the AI thinking, tool steps ticking off and an app building beside it. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
en.lede: The camera sits close on a chat panel: a prompt is typed into the composer and sent, the bubble springs up, the AI shows Thinking… and runs three tool-call cards that spin and tick off, the reply streams in word by word, and the camera pulls back as a blank preview beside the chat fills with an invoicing dashboard before the Mosaic lockup.
en.name: Chat Animation

body.h2: How to make a Chat Animation with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Build the chat as one panel of a 1500x840px window (chat 560px, preview 940px) and keep the camera tight on it at 1.75–1.85x for the first 5.9s, so 21px text reads at about 38px. Type the 51-character prompt into the composer from 0.7 to 1.95s, then press Send at 2.1s: the button squashes to 0.84 and bounces back with back.out(2.4), and the 420px user bubble springs in from the composer's position over 0.85s with back.out(1.25). Thinking… appears at 2.85s with a 1.1s highlight sweep and turns into a collapsed Thought for 2s row at 4.0s.

Show the work as tool steps. Three 504x64px cards appear at 4.0s, 4.7s and 5.35s with expo.out; each spinner turns two full rotations and becomes a purple tick at 4.62s, 5.22s and 5.95s. A 3px progress bar fills the blank preview from 4.0 to 6.0s. On the frame the last tick lands (5.95s) the preview swaps to the dashboard and the camera pulls back from 5.9 to 7.05s with expo.inOut, down to 1.16x. The reply streams 19 words 0.085s apart from 6.0s, each fading in over 0.3s, while the dashboard builds in parts until 7.8s.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the chat, the tool cards and a dashboard from your product. Replace the prompt, the three tool-step titles and the preview with your own, then fade the window at 8.2s and bring in the lockup at 8.45s. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.

en.alt: An AI chat panel next to the invoicing dashboard it just built, with revenue totals and a monthly bar chart.
faq: What is a chat animation in a product film?

A chat animation shows a conversation with an AI inside the product: a prompt is typed and sent, the assistant thinks, runs steps and answers, and the result appears beside it. Here the result is an invoicing dashboard that builds in the preview while the reply streams.
How do you make an AI reply look like it is streaming?

Fade each word in on its own tween. In this film the 19 words appear 0.085s apart, each over 0.3s with a 6px rise, so the reply takes about 1.5s. A caret follows the newest word, and a purple-to-pink copy of each word fades out over 0.5s starting 0.18s after it appears, so fresh words look newly generated.

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做聊天对话动画
body.body:
把对话做成 1500x840px 窗口里的一栏（对话栏 560px，预览区 940px），前 5.9s 镜头一直贴着它，放大 1.75–1.85 倍，21px 的文字读起来约 38px。0.7 到 1.95s 在输入框里打出 51 个字符的提示词，2.1s 按下发送：按钮缩到 0.84 再用 back.out(2.4) 回弹，420px 宽的用户气泡用 0.85s 从输入框的位置弹进线程，缓动 back.out(1.25)。2.85s 出现 Thinking…，一道高光用 1.1s 扫过，4.0s 换成折叠的 Thought for 2s。

把工作过程做成工具步骤。三张 504x64px 的卡片在 4.0s、4.7s、5.35s 用 expo.out 出现，每个转圈转两整圈，在 4.62s、5.22s、5.95s 变成紫色对勾；预览区顶部一条 3px 的进度条 4.0 到 6.0s 走满。最后一个对勾落下的同一帧（5.95s），预览区换成仪表盘，镜头 5.9 到 7.05s 用 expo.inOut 拉远到 1.16 倍。回复 6.0s 起逐词流出，19 个词间隔 0.085s，每个词淡入 0.3s，仪表盘同时分件长出，到 7.8s 结束。

点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会用你的产品做出对话栏、工具卡和仪表盘。把提示词、三个工具步骤的标题和预览换成你自己的，8.2s 窗口淡出，8.45s 字标出现。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。

zh.alt: AI 对话面板旁边是它刚做好的发票仪表盘，有收入数字和月度柱状图。
faq: 产品片里的聊天对话动画是什么？
聊天对话动画在产品里演示和 AI 的一次对话：输入并发送提示词，助手思考、执行步骤、给出回答，结果出现在旁边。这支片子里的结果是一个发票仪表盘，回复逐词流出的同时它在预览区里做出来。
怎么让 AI 回复看起来像在流式输出？
每个词单独做一段淡入。这支片子里 19 个词间隔 0.085s 出现，每个淡入 0.3s 并上移 6px，整段回复约 1.5s。光标跟在最新的词后面，每个词还叠一份紫到粉渐变的副本，在出现 0.18s 后用 0.5s 淡出，新词看起来像刚生成的。
